Andrej Karpathy explains AI better than anyone alive, so I built another Andrej Karpathy using Claude. It's not a voice clone. 

It's a Claude Code agent built from over 700,000 words of his lectures, blogs and posts, and it teaches the way he does. I'll show you the 4 steps to build your own, and once you've done it with Karpathy, you can do it with pretty much any expert you learn from.
